notes: CBER Advertising and Promotional Labeling Branch letter concerning a DTC TV ad for HIZENTRA (an approved BLA product): the ad is charged with misbranding under 502(n) for overstating efficacy and minimizing risk presentation. This is not a facility-inspection or CGMP letter (no facility was inspected; location_contains is null), and because HIZENTRA is already approved, unapproved_new_drug does not apply. is_sterile_product is marked true because HIZENTRA is inherently a sterile subcutaneous injectable per its labeling, even though sterility/manufacturing is not the subject of this letter (a judgment call). recall_concern is marked false because the letter only asks for a corrective-communication/discontinuation-of-the-ad plan, not a product recall or withdrawal from the market.
